Description: Comprehensive treatment plan for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus patients including lifestyle modifications, medications, and regular monitoring.
Goal: Maintain HbA1c below 7%, prevent complications, improve quality of life
Drug Comment: Take after meals. Start with low dose and increase gradually.
Drug Patient Instruction: Take with food to reduce stomach upset. Drink 1 litre water daily. Avoid alcohol.

Description: Standard treatment protocol for Essential Hypertension including lifestyle changes, medication, and regular BP monitoring.
Goal: Maintain BP below 130/80 mmHg, prevent cardiovascular complications
Drug Comment: Calcium channel blocker. Take at night.
Drug Patient Instruction: Take at the same time daily. Reduce salt intake. Exercise 30 mins daily. Avoid stress.

Description: Standard protocol for managing fever with symptomatic treatment and investigations to identify cause.
Goal: Reduce fever, identify underlying cause, prevent complications
Drug Patient Instruction: Take every 6-8 hours if fever persists. Drink plenty of fluids (2-3 litres water daily). Rest adequately. Sponge with lukewarm water if high fever.

Description: Treatment plan for hypothyroid patients with hormone replacement therapy.
Goal: Maintain TSH in normal range, improve energy levels
Drug Comment: Take on empty stomach in morning.
Drug Patient Instruction: Take 30-60 mins before breakfast. Avoid calcium/iron supplements for 4 hours. Regular TSH monitoring every 6-8 weeks initially.

Description: Treatment protocol for recurrent migraine headaches with preventive and acute management.
Goal: Reduce frequency and severity of migraine attacks
Drug Patient Instruction: Take at first sign of migraine. Rest in dark quiet room. Stay hydrated. Identify and avoid triggers.

Description: Treatment plan for gastroesophageal reflux disease with lifestyle modifications and medications.
Goal: Control acid reflux symptoms, prevent complications
Drug Patient Instruction: Avoid spicy/oily food. Don't lie down immediately after eating. Elevate head while sleeping. Eat small frequent meals.

Description: Treatment plan for iron deficiency anemia with iron supplementation.
Drug Comment: Take with Vitamin C for better absorption.
Drug Patient Instruction: Take with orange juice. Avoid tea/coffee for 2 hours. May cause dark stools (normal). Include iron-rich foods in diet.

Description: Treatment protocol for bronchial asthma with inhaler therapy.
Drug Patient Instruction: Rinse mouth after using inhaler. Identify and avoid triggers. Keep rescue inhaler always available. Follow up regularly.

Description: Standard treatment for urinary tract infection.
Drug Patient Instruction: Drink plenty of water (3+ litres daily). Don't hold urine. Complete full antibiotic course even if symptoms improve.

Description: Treatment plan for degenerative joint disease with pain management and physiotherapy.
Drug Patient Instruction: Apply warm compress to affected joints. Do gentle exercises. Maintain healthy weight. Avoid prolonged standing.
